verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a keyless JSON API for business-entity data (HTTP 200) at data.colorado.gov, and the docs point to that portal and the Intelligence Center for business data. However, this API is read-only, runs on the separate Socrata open-data platform rather than the registry, and nothing shows filings, name reservations, renewals or good-standing certificates can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: a documented API for transactional registry actions (filing, name reservation, periodic reports, certificates), first-party API reference documentation, and evidence of authenticated write access.
